36.text: are put the tributes in peltry coming to the Sun Chief from arctic Siberia. In the country of the Sun Chief

37.text: there is supposed to exist a great hole, from which boiling water continually flows, forming a whirlpool, and

38.text: threatening to submerge the whole world. The “spirit” of the whirlpool has to be propitiated with sacrifice of

39.text: peltries thrown into the water. The best combination is white and red foxes in equal numbers. When the

40.text: latter are deficient, the whirlpool turns angrily, refusing to accept the sacrifice. Therefore, when peltries are

41.text: scarce, the Sun Chief has to give, for those lacking, an equal number of cossack children. Besides this, every

42.text: tenth year he must throw in either two black foxes or his eldest son.

43.text: This is the only explanation that the mind of the Chukchee was able to work out in accounting for the
